summaryZh: Cherqui 实验室发展代谢和神经系统疾病的干细胞与基因治疗策略，并研究造血干细胞介导组织修复的机制。具体项目使用小鼠模型，家族性阿尔茨海默病项目采用 CRISPR 碱基编辑。
researchQuestions: 造血干细胞通过何种作用机制介导组织修复？
methods: CRISPR 碱基编辑（家族性阿尔茨海默病项目）

evidence.quote: About the Lab The main focus of the laboratory is the development of stem cell and gene therapy-based therapeutic approaches for metabolic and neurologic disorders, and the understanding of the mechanism of action for hematopoietic stem cell-mediated tissue repair. Meet the PI Dr. Cherqui is a professor at the University of California San Diego, Department of Pediatrics. She received her Ph.D in 2002 at Necker hospital (Paris, France); her research project focused on the molecular characterization of cystinosis, a metabolic hereditary disease, as well as the generation of mouse models. She then specialized in stem cells and gene therapy during her post-doctoral internship at The Scripps Research Institute where she was appointed Assistant Professor in 2009. In 2012, Dr. Cherqui joined the University of California, San Diego, Department of Pediatrics, Division of Genetics, became an Associate Professor in 2016, and Professor in 2022. Dr. Cherqui is a professor at the University of California San Diego, Department of Pediatrics.

In June 2021 Rafael joined the Cherqui lab as a Postdoc to continue developing therapeutic approaches for lysosomal storage diseases with a focus on stem cell transplantation and gene therapy using mouse models.

She joined the Cherqui lab in September 2025 to pursue her passion for developing novel therapeutics targeting brain disease states. Her current project involves correcting a point mutation in the amyloid precursor protein (APP) gene in hematopoietic stem cells using advanced CRISPR base-editing tools as treatment for familial Alzheimer’s disease.

The main focus of the laboratory is the development of stem cell and gene therapy-based therapeutic approaches for metabolic and neurologic disorders, and the understanding of the mechanism of action for hematopoietic stem cell-mediated tissue repair.
